text:
On a lovely farm beside a sparkling pond, a mother duck sat patiently on her nest. One by one, the eggs cracked open — pop, pop, pop! Out tumbled five fluffy yellow ducklings.

But the biggest egg was still hatching. When it finally opened, out came a large, grey, awkward little bird.

The other ducklings laughed at him. "You're so UGLY!" they quacked. "You don't look like us at all!" Even the farm animals teased him. Only his mother was kind.

The little grey duckling felt very sad and very lonely. "Why am I so different?" he wondered.

Unable to bear the teasing any longer, the duckling ran away from the farm. He wandered through fields and marshes, looking for somewhere he belonged. Everywhere he went, birds and animals turned away and called him ugly.

He was cold, hungry, and very, very alone.

Winter came and the pond froze over. The poor duckling shivered beneath a hollow log, barely surviving the bitter cold. He dreamed of spring and of finding friends who would love him just as he was.

"Will anyone ever care for me?" he asked the silent snowflakes.

At last, spring arrived! The ice melted, flowers bloomed, and warm sunshine filled the world. The duckling stretched his wings — they felt enormous and powerful!

He flapped them once… twice… and to his amazement, he FLEW up into the clear blue sky!

He glided down to a beautiful lake and landed on the shimmering water. He peered at his reflection and could not believe his eyes.

The ugly grey duckling was gone. Instead, a magnificent white swan gazed back at him — graceful, beautiful, and perfect!

A group of elegant swans swam over and welcomed him warmly. "You're one of us!" they said joyfully.

Children on the bank pointed and gasped, "Look at that beautiful swan!" For the first time in his life, the swan felt happy, loved, and exactly where he belonged.

🌟 THE END 🌟

💡 Moral: Everyone is beautiful in their own special way!
